_readme: Golden sample for tests/db/apply-extract.test.ts, same shape as data/reference/golden/*.golden.json.
Expected values were worked out by hand from the raw cell strings in the fixtures: '208 Gbps' -> 208 Gbit/s,
'32,000' on an English-locale sheet -> 32000, '10 to 35 C' -> {min 10, max 35} °C. The extractor's output was
NOT copied and blessed. NZT-UCS-C240's expectation sits on the PDF fixture so the PDF re-read path is graded too.
